caption: Diagram 2.29 Wall type 3.2 with independent composite panels
description: The image features a pale green header at the top containing the text "Diagram 2.29" on the left and the title "Wall type 3.2 with independent composite panels" on the right. Below this is a technical line drawing labelled "SECTION" in the bottom right corner. The drawing depicts a vertical cross-section of a wall. In the center, there is a column composed of four distinct rectangular panels stacked vertically, each containing an 'X' shaped cross-hatch pattern. Flanking this central structure on both the left and right sides are separate vertical layers, represented by double lines. There is a visible gap or cavity separating the central column from these outer layers. The drawing is enclosed in a simple black rectangular frame.
